zh-CN.title: 打开更快，切换更稳
items: 聊天、广场、菜单等页面改为按需加载，并在切换前智能预载
语言包仅在需要时下载，切换过程保留原界面并提供加载反馈
弱网下页面资源加载失败时可以安全重试

en.title: Faster starts and smoother switching
items: Chat, Square, Menu, and other pages now load on demand with smart preloading
Language packs download only when needed while the current interface stays visible
Page resources can now be retried safely when a weak connection interrupts loading
